title: GMN v2: Galilean-frame convolutions with human-in-the-loop deferral for touchless gesture control
description: Code, subject-group split files and unit tests for GMN v2, a glass-box hand-gesture recognizer for Leap Motion skeletal data with calibrated human-in-the-loop deferral, evaluated under a leakage-free subject-wise protocol on LeapGestureDB and LMDHG. The datasets are not redistributed; obtain them from their original providers.
